## Common questions

Short answers to what comes up most.

GEO stands for Generative Engine Optimization. It means getting your brand into the answer when someone asks ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Perplexity what to buy. Notra measures where you appear in those answers and shows you how to improve it. [...] ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity with web search, plus Google AI Overview and coding agents that research live. Models from Moonshot, Z.AI, DeepSeek, Meta and Grok run without web search. You pick which ones run, and the model list refreshes as new releases ship.

One prompt asked to one engine in one language on one scan. Ten prompts across five engines in two languages, scanned every 48 hours, is about 1,500 answers a month.

You don't need one. Add @usenotra/geo as a proxy or middleware in your Next.js, Nuxt, TanStack Start, Astro or SvelteKit site. It posts a small request envelope to Notra, we do the matching on our side and anything human is dropped before it is stored.

## What the Notraconnector does

Notra is a GEO tool, which stands for Generative Engine Optimization. It asks AI answer engines the questions your buyers ask, then shows whether your brand appears, which brands appear instead, and how to improve. Marketing teams use it to track prompts and competitors. Founders use it for their first tracked prompts, and agencies use it for several brands at once. Notra, Inc. makes it. [...] Does the agent change anything in Notra without asking?

No. The agent asks before it changes anything in Notra. That includes creating and deleting items. Check the agent's answers before you act on them, especially when it names competitors or drafts posts.

What does GEO mean in Notra?

GEO stands for Generative Engine Optimization. Notra asks AI answer engines the prompts you track, then checks each answer for your brand, aliases and competitors. You see how often you are mentioned, your position, and your share of voice. Scans run every day by default.
